scenarios.name: Minimize and restore the ribbon during a modeling preview

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` with its solid block is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the ribbon display control toggles between full display and tabs only
the Shell properties panel and model preview appear
the user clicks the ribbon display control
only the ribbon tabs remain visible
the Shell properties panel and model preview remain visible
the user clicks the ribbon display control again
the Shell properties panel and model preview remain visible
the Shell properties panel and preview close
the original solid block remains visible
